name: zeffect_anim_find_next_async_entry
description: zEffectAnim::FindNextAsyncEntry returns the next animation entry with the async callback flag after the current entry, or the first such entry when currentEntry is null.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final byte matching should be handled with the coherent zEffectAnim source-cluster pass because surrounding animation-entry table code depends on shared entry layout and VC pointer-difference codegen.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x45ffa0 validates fastcall ECX=currentEntry, null currentEntry starting from index 0, pointer-difference index recovery with 0x134-byte zEffectAnimEntry stride, signed g_zEffectAnim_EntryCount comparison, testing byte flag 0x10 at entry offset 0x94, returning the matching entry pointer, and returning null when no later async entry exists.
The native smoke verifies first async lookup from null, lookup after a current async entry, and null return after the final async entry against a four-entry g_zEffectAnim_EntryList.
